articles.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
articles.description: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

articles.title: Solana treasury firm SkyAI sells all SOL holdings, launches $201M buyback
articles.description: The former medical device maker has liquidated its Solana treasury and is offering to repurchase shares and warrants using its $223.8 million cash holdings.

articles.title: Crypto PAC pours $362K into California race voters essentially decided in August
articles.description: A Fairshake affiliate is supporting incumbent Aisha Wahab through ads in November, but the congresswoman already won a special election in the district.

articles.title: Tether: Senator's investigation misses positive work that's led to lower Iran volumes
articles.description: The stablecoin issuer's CEO, Paolo Ardoino, has been defending against accusations that the firm's stablecoins have fueled financial activity in Iran.

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
articles.description: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Market participants weigh in on SEC’s proposed crypto regulations
articles.description: The financial agency is scheduled to close public comments on its ‘Regulation Crypto Assets’ proposed in August.

articles.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
articles.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

articles.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
articles.description: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.

articles.title: Mastercard launches stablecoin risk screening for banks and payment providers
articles.description: The new service combines payment data and blockchain analytics to help banks detect suspicious stablecoin transactions before settlement.

articles.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
articles.description: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

articles.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
articles.description: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

articles.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
articles.description: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

articles.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
articles.description: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

articles.title: Rivian’s CEO says autonomy will enable ‘dramatically different’ vehicle designs
articles.description: Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe said he thinks autonomy will allow his company to build radically different kinds of vehicles than the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

articles.title: Revolut secures Gibraltar crypto license to support global expansion
articles.description: The UK-based fintech will use the authorization to offer crypto services in additional international markets, though it has not disclosed specific countries or launch dates.

articles.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
articles.description: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
articles.description: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.

articles.title: Metaplanet to take 93.7% stake in Super League through 2,100 BTC deal
articles.description: The transaction would give Metaplanet access to US capital markets, where it plans to use preferred stock offerings to finance additional Bitcoin purchases.

articles.title: Strive buys $335M in Bitcoin, boosting holdings to 36,818 BTC
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury company added another 1,223 BTC after an earlier purchase pushed it past MARA Holdings, while continuing to expand its reserves through equity financing.
